entities.name: Luis Jiménez de Asúa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Jiménez de Asúa was a jurist and Spanish politician. He was vice president of the Spanish parliament and representative of that country before the United Nations. During the Francoist dictatorship he exiled himself to Argentina. In 1962 he was named president of the Spanish Republican government in Exile.

entities.summary: Luis Jiménez de Asúa was a jurist and Spanish politician. He was vice president of the Spanish parliament and representative of that country before the United Nations.
